name: POKE Virtual Sensor (PIT-based)
description: Virtual sensors using PIT timer for pseudo-random values. No kernel modification needed.

operations.name: read_temperature
operations.desc: Read simulated temperature (PIT-based, varies per call, 20-35°C range)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 1500
div ecx
add eax, 2000
ret
